[b]A Royal Invitation[/b]

It was now September of 2028, a month had passed since the Rosenmarkket government had collapsed, and while lingering suspicions of Strømmist activity and SCSID activity lingered in the background, the Montfleurois administration that had been put into place did much to dispense with teh old system while maintaining services and some form of continuity.

Investment was a big question that ran through the minds of Montfleurois economists who were fully aware they had just inherited a far wealthier economy than that of Montfleur, and as such, they understood the importance of ensuring business continued as normally as possible under similar regulations. 

To celebrate the first month of the collapse and the first month of the unification, King Henri decided to invite dignitaries and the Wuloosyan president to the opening of the first McRonalds in the history of Rosenmarkke.
-------
[nation]The Commonwealth Provisional States[/nation]

[quote=the_commonwealth_provisional_states;61712596][b]Authorization for Use of Military Force Against Romarii[/b]

[sub]An act to[/sub]

Authorize the Wuloosyan Defense Forces, under the command of the President of the United Commonwealth to be used (1) defend U.K national security against the continuing threat posed by Rommarii; (2) See to it that the terms of the Ultimatum of April 20th, 2028, are fulfilled in full; and (3) See to it that the regime in Romarii, with the asistance of International Partners is completely removed.

Whereas, the reasonable terms of the Ultimatum of April 20th, 2028 have been thus far flagrantly ignored, and no earnest effort has been made to speedily complete them.

Whereas, the Ultimatum of April 20th, 2028, plainly declared that "Failure to respond will be treated as a rejection of its terms. It should be noted that failure to comply now will result in harsher terms later."

Whereas, the current Romarii regime has shown a complete willingness to use weapons of mass destruction against other nations and its own people.

Whereas, it has become clear to this congress assembled that no force, outside of military force, will bring a resolution favorable to international justice and peace

Be it resolved by the Censorate, Senate, and House of Representatives of the United Commonwealth of Wuloosya assembled that...

Section 1, Short Title

This act may be refered to as "Authorization for Use of Military Force Against Romarii"

Section 2, Authorization

(A) The President is authorized to use the Defense Forces of Wuloosya as he deems to be necessary and reasonable against the Romariian government and military. 

(B) The President will inform Congress, specifically the Censorate Consul, Senate President Pro Tempore, and House Speaker, about any military action or operation within 48 hours of its beginning.

(C) Within the next 60 days, the Department of War will submit a detailed report of the war, including (1) losses and casualties among men and equipment; (2) enemy losses and casualties; (3) completion of the war goals specified in this resolution.

(D) Within the next 60 days, the Secretary of War will report to the Censorate for a hearing on the progress of the war.

Voting on this resolution will now begin...

[b]Operation Magikarp [/b]

With authorization formally granted by Congress, the President formed the "General Command Room for War Operations in Romarii" or GCRWOR, like the JROWSC that had been formed months earlier during the conflict with Rosenmarkkee, General Matthias Vanderrow was chosen to head the special command, which would be based out of Pangoro Harbor, a lagoon harbor and a deepwater naval base of the WDNK located in the New Calvera Territory. This base was chosen for its strategic location, sheltered by the wider Chiamor Sea. A part of this command would also be once again Hendel Crossrik representing the navy, although unlike the time, he would not be given the same command powers as Vanderrow, and Commandant Hubrecht Schouder representing the WDMK, who would likely take the brunt of the expected casualties during this operation. Like the war with Rosenmarkkee, it was highly likely that all branches would take part in some form during the course of operations. The OSS and the National Intelligence Center would be tasked with gathering intelligence in the country, so preparations could be made for the best strategy to overthrow the Romarii government and ensure the liberation of the islands. The OSS would begin to slowly position intelligence assets such as 5 KH-100 Deoxys Electro-optical imaging reconnaissance satellites and 2 Rayquaza  Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging reconnaissance satellites. These satellites would provide near-real-time imaging of most of the country and the entirety of the islands, with these high-definition images of targets such as military bases, storage and fuel depots, government offices, command facilities and bunkers, communication and early warning stations, troop and equipment movements, and infrastructure vulnerabilities all being sent to GCRWOR. The SAR sattlites would also capture anything more hidden by things like trees or cloud cover. The UKS Devran Crestfield, a signals intelligence ship, would be deployed outside of the EEZ of the islands, masking itself as if it were in transit and therefore legally operating in the area, intercepting communications and feeding them back to the NIC listening station on Montea. These communications would then be decrypted and their contents sent to the OSS. Also at the Montea Listening Stations, several arrays would be pointed at known Romarii communication satellites to see if any unencrypted communications could be gained from this.

Three NIC Agents, highly trained operatives, would enter the country under false identities; two of these identities would be PanWuloosan Airlines pilots on layover in two different major cities while the company decided on the best strategy to cease operations in the country temporarily to comply with the embargo. And the other would be a crew member on a Wuloosyan cargo ship who was in charge of packing up goods due to the embargo. All three men would at times sneak out of their expected areas and "wander" near government buildings, taking photos, acting as if they were simply tourists having a fun time. These photos would the be forwarded back to the NIC. Additionally, while they were at airports and ports, they would make sure to capture photos and note down the locations of any military equipment, like aircraft or ships. Since they were given a substantial amount of the country's money obtained through previous trading with the nation, whenever safe, they would attempt to bribe civilian or military personnel near these locations for any information they may not have access to, and any would-be informants would get the money and promises from the Wuloosyan government of safety for their assistance. 

Meanwhile, at GCRWOR, planning the invasion of the islands, followed up by an even hypothetical larger invasion of the Romarii mainland, would prove difficult.  Such a task would prove difficult; unlike the limited Rosenmarkkett war, this one would be a full-scale campaign and would likely take months to even a year to ensure the completion of the lofty goals set by Congress and the President. News that Wuloosya would hopefully be joined by an international force calmed concerns in GCRWOR Command and the OSS. The GCRWOR estimated a substantial portion of the WDF would need to be deployed during the operation, especially during something like an occupation. The 5th Armored Division, 1st Cavalry Division, 4th Motorized Division,  8th Airborne Division, 3rd Ranger Regiment, and the 1st Marine Division and 2nd Marine Division were the generally agreed-upon forces needed to ensure objectives on the ground. This meant the transportation of around  79,500 troops, 310 Tanks,  2,370 IFV/APCs, 288 Artillery Pecies, 144 Air Defense Units, 100 reconnaissance vehicles, and 8,300 logistical and utility vehicles to the staging point for the operations, which would be Montea and New Calvera. A daunting task for a nation that had never made such large military movements. To assist in this task, the President activated the Civil Airlift Reserve Transport Command and the Civil Sealift Transport Command. This agreement had been signed between the WDF and a few companies in Wuloosya that would allow the temporary acquisition of their equipment in times of emergency for transporting troops and equipment to anywhere the WDF needed to go. 30 of Panwul's aircraft, all primarily QA-11s (MD-11s) and QA-777s (Boeing 777s) would be leased, along with Macro Comos providing 20 of its QA-747s (Boeing 747s) for the mission. In terms of sealift, Macro Cosmos would again provide 20 of its cargo ships,  while Wooseny would provide two of its massive cruise liners, the Wooseny Fantasy and Wooseny Dream. This equipment would all quickly be painted military grey, and the cruise ships would be armed with limited air defense capability and hastily modified with thousands of bunks, increasing their capacity to 15,000 and 20,000, respectively. This massive build-up would take around 4 weeks.

[b]Protest at Niedchatzegram[/b]

Nikhola rose at 6 am with a fire in his chest. There was a march planned in the big city, which he helped to organize. He had been a part the Niedchatzegram chapter of the Free Cieskah organization and affiliated with the former DPRUC party officials. The NCFCO (Nikhola's people) and organized several marches in the months prior while attempting to pause Extraction Operations that hadn't even gotten a Republican vote. Despite their failures, they switched gears and are now demanding an audience with the Imperial Powers.

Nikhola dawned dark cargo pants and a sheer black t-shirt, as it was gonna be a hot one out in the city. He packed cases of water, snacks, and ice-filled coolers into his car, then went back inside. It was about nine and thirty, the time his dad usually began to stir. His father was an old man who had a hard time with stairs, so Nikhola moved in a few months prior, just after turning 29. He told his father he'd be heading off, and that he'd arranged for Aunt Kamina to come by in an hour.

He drove his car north up the newly redone Arterial Highway to Niedtchatzegram. By 10, protesters and activists had already taken to the sidewalks and parks, chatting, swapping numbers, and getting ready for the march. It was a simple plan for the day: gather, march, and use the press attention from marching to make their announcement. When he arrived, he scanned the crowd for the NCFCO organizers. At 11, they all started walking around the city.

The crowd sang folk songs, waved flags, and held signs with messages like: "Bring back a Red Cieskahlia", "Self Determination Now!". Nikhola held a big banner at the front of the line, his boyfriend Emil holding the other side. They each carried with them a list of demands from the NCFCO on behalf of the Cieskah people. They wanted true representation for Cieskahlia in the Imperial Structure. They wanted the freedom to legislate their homeland as they saw fit, and a reformation of the Imperial Structures to further the ends of the Revolution.

[spoiler=Dismantling the factories]
Romariian News Network
---------------------------
Romariia has completed removing its chemical factories
---------------------------
After Romariia was faced with the Ultimatum made by Wuloosya on April 20th, the government has slowly dismantled its military chemical factories using the RGF and the RISF, and today, the last chemical factory, which is in northern West Romariia, has been dismantled.

The Government has also transitioned some of its civilian chemical factories, some for everyday use, to be monitored by the International Forum. The Government has stated that it will transition these factories gradually to reduce the risk of instability.

Although this might satisfy the ultimatum, the dismantling has led to the loss of several hundred thousand jobs, according to recent data.

Experts have warned that these former workers may radicalize and oppose the government, as in many of the chemical factories, many communists were protecting them.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Finishing the Memorial]
Romariian News Network
---------------------------
Yoshiland Memorial site has finished construction.
---------------------------
The Yoshiland Memorial site, which sits on the remains of the victims of the April 12th incident, and was burned during construction, was finished earlier today after intense diplomatic pressure.
The site spanned 2 km wide and 5 km long, which marks the Yoshiland Memorial Site as the 5th biggest site in Romariia.

Although to its giant size, there are not that many burial sites due to most of the corpses from the April 12th incident have been burned by rioters on April 24th.

The Government has also given several hundred thousand Aerums to the Victim's Families, just as the Ultimatum insisted, altough some of the families have returned the Money back to the government.

The Families of the Victims have hoped that this memorial will decrease tensions and massacres in not just Romariia, but also Elyser and the rest of Erene.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler= [i]"Workers of Romariia, unite!"[/i]]
Romariian News Network Live Broadcasting
---------------------------
The CDF consolidated the northern regions of the Romariia Federal Group
---------------------------
The Communist Defense Force, or CDF, has taken most control of the northern regions of the Romariia Federal Group.

The Extremist Group was formed very recently, on April 20th. Its intentions and Origins are currently unknown, but experts and government officials are sure that the group originated from Socialist International, as most of the CDF's activities are near the border with Socialist International, and seeks to expand communism and socialism to Imperium Romae Marii.

It has been increasingly popular since the Government has started taking down factories; the extremist group has also stolen weapons from the government, and caused massive civilian injuries and casualties.

The CDF has also drafted itself to become a Political Party in Imperium Romae Marii; experts, however, warn that allowing the CDF to become a Political Party would cause Imperium Romae Marii to be more unstable due to the Political Parties increasing from 2 to 3.
[/spoiler]

[b]Massacre in Western View[/b]
August 3, 2028

Valmornian and Guhui'Bernardio troops marched into Freyn Tradion territory yesterday supported by Sallach infantry divisions that had gone in and blocked off key points that would've helped Frey Tradion evacuate. The support ships sent also blockaded incoming trade from Italian Dutch. Soon Valmornian and GB troops started to blow up buildings taking innocent civilians and FT members without hesitation. That's not to say that FT didn't fight back. Very quickly snipers with rifles from across Erene were laying down a hail of bullets with machine gunners that had anything and everything from modified AK-47s to M249s, even a M240 removed from a wrecked tank. The fight raged on and on but eventually around 100 Valmornian and GB troops managed to flank FT's defending force and reach the warehouse where most of the "generals" (they're not really generals but they do control a good portion of FT's "military") in Wessernia were stationed (note that the highest leaders were not there at the time and were most likely in Farie). The "generals", their guards, the families, and many wounded FT members were trapped in the warehouse. Very quickly Vamornians and GB members were able to infiltrate and massacre at least half of those inside the warehouse including many children. The ware house was then bombed out by Valmornia and Gb with at least 25% of those inside taking hostage (mostly "generals" and "officers"). It is estimated that 49% of those in the warehouse were killed (mostly family members and wounded) and only a small sliver were able to escape.
